displayPattern: Status LED flashing rapidly without a pause
meaning: Line voltage (115 VAC) polarity reversed. If twinned, check 24 V transformer phasing.
causes: Improper low-voltage transformer phasing on twinned units
diySteps: Technician: check for correct line voltage polarity
Technician: if twinned, refer to twinning kit instructions
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: line-voltage wiring must be corrected by a qualified person.
